name: com.madar-transport/madar-transport
title: Madar Transport
description: Coach and minibus hire with driver for groups in Egypt: plan the trip, send a quote request.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Madar Transport's facts: what it does and does not do, where it operates, what a price includes and excludes, how to book, the vehicle size by headcount, contact details (WhatsApp, phone, email), commercial registration and tax card. Start here.

lang.description: Language of the answer: 'ar' (Egyptian Arabic) or 'en'. Default 'en'.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Every service Madar offers (conference transport, bus rental, minibus rental, airport transfers, intercity trips, tour groups, church trips, weddings and events, sports teams, Hajj and Umrah groups, employee transport), each with a short description and its page URL.

lang.description: Language of the answer: 'ar' (Egyptian Arabic) or 'en'. Default 'en'.

tools.name: list_fleet
tools.description: Every vehicle size Madar hires out with its driver: seats, where the luggage goes, a description, photos and its page URL. Vehicles are hired whole, never by the seat.

lang.description: Language of the answer: 'ar' (Egyptian Arabic) or 'en'. Default 'en'.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: The cities and districts Madar serves (Mansoura and every Dakahlia district first, the Delta, Cairo, Alexandria, Sinai, the Red Sea, Siwa, Luxor, Aswan) and the Luxor/Aswan tour movements (temples, airports, cruise docks, Abu Simbel, Luxor–Hurghada), each with its page URL.

lang.description: Language of the answer: 'ar' (Egyptian Arabic) or 'en'. Default 'en'.

tools.name: recommend_vehicle
tools.description: Recommends the vehicle size (and how many) for a group from the headcount (every child counts as a seat) and the luggage, using Madar's own rule: HiAce up to 13, Coaster 14–21, midibus 22–33, coach 34–50, more vehicles above that; suitcases that must be locked away start at the midibus; foreign tourist groups ride licensed tourist vehicles. Madar confirms the final size in its quote.

bags_locked_away.description: True if the bags must ride in a closed hold, not on a roof rack or inside

foreign_tourists.description: True for a group of foreign tourists

lang.description: Language of the answer: 'ar' (Egyptian Arabic) or 'en'. Default 'en'.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Keyword search over every page of madar-transport.com (services, vehicles, cities, Luxor/Aswan movements, FAQs). Returns titles, URLs and the matching line. Search in Arabic or English.

query.description: What to look for, in Arabic or English

lang.description: Language of the answer: 'ar' (Egyptian Arabic) or 'en'. Default 'en'.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full text of one page of madar-transport.com (a service, a vehicle, a city or a Luxor/Aswan movement), by its URL or path, e.g. /en/fleet/toyota-coaster or https://www.madar-transport.com/ar/services/conference-transport.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends the traveller's trip to Madar Transport as a quote request (or a booking request with ready_to_book), with the traveller's own name and WhatsApp/phone — only with their permission. The request goes straight to Madar and their team is notified at once; nothing is booked or charged. It returns a reference to give the traveller, and an optional WhatsApp link if they want to add details; Madar replies with a written price within the day, by WhatsApp or phone. Ask for the day-by-day programme with start and end times for any trip longer than one day. Use dry_run to test without sending.

traveller_name.description: The traveller's or group leader's name

whatsapp_or_phone.description: Their WhatsApp or phone number, with country code if outside Egypt

pickup.description: Exact pick-up place (hotel, address, airport and terminal)

stops.description: Stops on the way, if any

return_date.description: Return date and time, if returning on another day

days.description: Number of days the vehicle is needed

programme.description: Day-by-day programme: places, and start and end time of each day

service.description: e.g. conference transport, airport transfer, day trip

driver_overnight.description: For multi-day trips: who covers the driver's accommodation and meals

language.description: Language of the WhatsApp message (default en)

ready_to_book.description: True if the traveller wants to book once the price is confirmed

assistant.description: Your name, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without sending anything
